label: GitHub Copilot Pro
harnesses: Copilot in VS Code / Visual Studio / JetBrains / Eclipse / Xcode / Neovim / Zed
models: All plans: Claude Haiku 4.5/5.5, Sonnet 5/5.5, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra, GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.1 Terra, Grok 4.5/4.6/4.7, Kimi K3, MAI-Code-1.1-Flash (plans docs, 2026-11-15). Pro has no Opus, Fable, Gemini 4 Argon/Carbon, GPT-6 Astra or the Sol models.
limits: "Every plan includes a monthly allowance: 1 AI credit = $0.01 USD." Pro: Base 1,000 + flex 500 = 1,500 credits/month ($15). "Flex allotments may change over time." "Code completions and next edit suggestions don't use credits."
notes: Usage-based since 2026-06-01: credits are drawn at per-model rates, so this behaves like a ~1.5x prepaid credit, not a rate window. OpenCode is officially supported for paid plans (changelog 2026-01-16). Third-party agents (Claude, Codex) inside Copilot need Pro+ or higher per the features page, though the plans docs table marks them 'Included' for Pro. New signups for Pro/Pro+/Max were paused on 2026-04-20 and reopened gradually from 2026-06-17 ('We're reopening sign-ups for GitHub Copilot Student, Pro, Pro+, and Max plans'); the plans page shows 'Get started' on every plan. Per the April changelog, Opus was removed from Pro. Annual price not shown on current pages. Per-token prices (models-and-pricing, 2026-11-15) match the providers' list prices, except Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon at a promotional $2/$10 per MTok until 2026-12-01.

label: GitHub Copilot Pro+
harnesses: Third-party agents in Copilot: Claude, Codex (preview)
models: Everything on Pro plus Claude Opus 4.8/5/5.5, Fable 5/5.1/5.2, Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon, GPT-5.4 nano, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol (plans docs, 2026-11-15).
limits: Base 3,900 + flex 3,100 = 7,000 AI credits/month ($70). "1 AI credit = $0.01 USD." "Flex allotments may change over time."
notes: Credit plan worth ~1.8x its price at list model rates. Signups reopened from 2026-06-17 (see Pro). Per-token prices (models-and-pricing, 2026-11-15) match the providers' list prices, except Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon at a promotional $2/$10 per MTok until 2026-12-01.

label: GitHub Copilot Max
harnesses: Third-party agents in Copilot: Claude, Codex (preview)
models: Everything on Pro plus Claude Opus 4.8/5/5.5, Fable 5/5.1/5.2, Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon, GPT-5.4 nano, GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol (plans docs, 2026-11-15).
limits: Base 10,000 + flex 10,000 = 20,000 AI credits/month ($200). "built for heavy Copilot usage, including sustained agent-driven workflows".
notes: Announced 2026-06-01 as an upgrade for existing subscribers. OpenCode support is stated for 'paid Copilot subscriptions (Pro, Pro+, Business, Enterprise)' as of January, before Max existed, so Max is assumed to be covered. Per-token prices (models-and-pricing, 2026-11-15) match the providers' list prices, except Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon at a promotional $2/$10 per MTok until 2026-12-01.
